summary: MantisBT is a self-hosted PHP issue/bug tracker: ADOdb DB layer, admin/schema.php migrations, Command-class business layer under a Slim REST API plus XML-RPC/SOAP API and procedural web action pages. Persisted CRUD entities: issues (Bug), bugnotes, users, projects, categories, versions, tags, custom fields, files, saved filters, config, news, API tokens, relationships, monitoring, sponsorship, revisions, tokens.
